nodes.label: R-Debater: Retrieval-Augmented Debate Generation
nodes.author: Maoyuan Li, Zhongsheng Wang, Haoyuan Li, Jiamou Liu
nodes.rationale: Agentic framework integrating retrieval-augmented reasoning with role-based planning for multi-turn debate; achieves 76.32% human preference over baselines; near-perfect logical coherence

nodes.label: Argumentative Memory: Rhetorical Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Debate as iterative reconstruction of prior reasoning contexts; retrieval function R recalls early memory; reasoning function M adapts to current debate context; maintains stance consistency across turns

nodes.label: Debate Knowledge Base Construction
nodes.rationale: Segments debate transcripts into utterance-level units; annotates with 7 argumentation schemes (example-based, expert opinion, positive/negative consequence, causal, analogical, value-based); scores scheme quality

nodes.label: Logic & Summarization Agent
nodes.rationale: Analyzes opponent utterances via pseudo-first-order predicates; reconstructs reasoning chains; identifies logical flaws (contradictions, unsupported assumptions, circular reasoning); produces interpretable control signals

nodes.label: Debate Generation with Iterative Verification
nodes.rationale: Generates initial utterance; Judgement Agent evaluates stance faithfulness, argumentative relevance, scheme compliance; Text Modification Agent revises until criteria satisfied; iterative refinement loop

nodes.label: R-Debater uses Logic & Summarization Agent for opponent analysis
